note: Nebula light takes (Blender pass 430). Each part is a lathe round the lantern's axis (x=z=0 in the nebula_lantern.bbmodel frame, model px): 'profile' is [y, radius] pairs from top to bottom, turned into 'segments' quads round the axis ('every': draw only every n-th segment, for a cage). UV: u = k/segments (the strip's frame wraps once round, so its own tiling closes the seam); v = arc length down the profile / (2*pi*max radius), so texels are square at the widest ring. u and v are fractions of ONE strip frame (the block-atlas sprite's u0..u1, v0..v1).

L1_column.look: Today's light column, wrapped in the strip

L2_orb.look: A ball of light in the middle band; the ends of the glass stay dark

L3_crystal.look: An eight-sided crystal with pointed ends

L4_core_cage.look: A thin core inside a barred sleeve, both in the strip: the bars turn over the core
